title: Pregnancy Prevention REMS — US (teratogen ETASU program)
summary: About 2,400 prescribers and 600 pharmacies certified through training, knowledge assessment and attestation with NPI checks and recertification; patients enrolled by portal, fax or phone with two forms of contraception and monthly pregnancy tests; dispense authorizations auto-checked or referred, with a 7-day window; pharmacy staff lists; non-compliance findings with responses and corrective action; prescriber, pharmacy and patient 360 pages and an FDA assessment report.
